# Deploy to Amazon ECS

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Register a new ECS task definition with an updated image and roll the service

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-aws-ecs@v1
  with:
    cluster: # ECS cluster name or ARN.
    service: # ECS service name.
    image: # Image to deploy. Use an immutable digest ref (`repo@sha256:…`) where possible.
```

## How it works

Roll a new image onto an ECS service.

The task definition is fetched live from ECS rather than read from a committed JSON file.
That matters: a committed file drifts the moment anyone changes anything in the console or
via Terraform, and deploying it silently reverts those changes. Fetching the active
revision, swapping only the image (and any overrides you ask for), and registering a new
revision means a deploy changes exactly one thing.

Set `task-definition-file` if you genuinely want the committed file to be the source of
truth — appropriate when Terraform owns the definition and CI only bumps the tag.

Authenticate with `aws-auth` first. Requires `wait-for-stability` time budget; the default
10 minutes covers a rolling deploy of a small service with health checks.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster` | **yes** | — | ECS cluster name or ARN. |
| `service` | **yes** | — | ECS service name. |
| `image` | **yes** | — | Image to deploy. Use an immutable digest ref (`repo@sha256:…`) where possible. |
| `container-name` | no | `""` | Container in the task definition to update. Empty uses the first container. |
| `task-definition-file` | no | `""` | Path to a task-definition JSON to use as the base. Empty (default) fetches the service's currently active revision from ECS. |
| `task-definition-family` | no | `""` | Family to describe when no service exists yet. Empty uses the service's family. |
| `environment-variables` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` env vars merged into the container definition. |
| `secrets` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=arn` pairs mapped to the container's `secrets` (Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store ARNs). These are references, not values. |
| `desired-count` | no | `""` | Override the service's desired task count. Empty leaves it unchanged. |
| `wait-for-stability` | no | `true` | true to block until the service reaches a steady state. |
| `wait-timeout-minutes` | no | `10` | How long to wait for stability before failing. |
| `force-new-deployment` | no | `false` | true to force a new deployment even when the task definition is unchanged. |
| `codedeploy-appspec` | no | `""` | Path to an AppSpec file, for blue/green services managed by CodeDeploy. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `task-definition-arn` | ARN of the task definition revision that was registered and deployed. |
| `revision` | The new task definition revision number. |
